title: This Guy Instantly Regretted Running from Police
description:
When officers responded to a 911 call at a car wash, they stumbled upon a man passed out in his car with not one, but two vacuums running at the same time. After detaining him and putting him in the back of the police car, things went out of control in a matter of seconds. Brandon Lindsay pleaded no contest to multiple charges, including evading an officer and DUI.

event_summary.short: Suspect passed out in car at car wash, fled on foot when detained, tased, later escaped from patrol car before being re-arrested. Charged with DUI, theft, resisting, escape, concealing identity, and drug possession.
